title: Integer multiplicity currents of dimension at least one do not charge the origin (parent step 8, B0.1)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1, and let C ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ m) be integer multiplicity. Let ω_k ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (k ∈ ℕ), r_k ∈ ℝ with r_k → 0, and c ∈ ℝ. Assume ω_k(x) = 0 whenever r_k ≤ |x|, and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω_k(x)) ≤ c for all k and x. Then C(ω_k) → 0 as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), r k ≤ ‖x‖ → (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x = 0) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), covectorEuclideanNorm ((ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ c) → Tendsto (fun k => C (ωs k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
